segments.caption: A static, intricate sculpture made of matchsticks stands upright on a white surface, its structure forming a spiraling, columnar pattern with red-tipped matches creating a bold, winding design against a plain, light-colored background.
A static, intricate sculpture made of numerous toothpicks with red tips stands upright on a white surface, its complex, spiraling structure remaining completely still across all frames.
A hand holds a lit match and slowly brings it toward a tall, spiraling tower made of unlit matches, casting a warm glow on the structure as the flame approaches.
A spiral tower of matchsticks is ignited at the top, and the fire rapidly spreads downward, engulfing the entire structure in a bright, consuming blaze.
A spiral tower of matchsticks is engulfed in flames, burning steadily as the fire climbs upward, illuminating the structure against a plain background.
A fire burns intensely within a spiral structure made of wooden sticks, its flames licking upwards and casting a warm, flickering glow that illuminates the surrounding darkness.
A spiral structure made of matchsticks burns intensely, with bright orange and yellow flames consuming the material from the top down, casting a warm glow on the surrounding dark surface.
A tall, spiraling structure made of matchsticks stands upright as it burns, with flames leaping vigorously from its top and sides, illuminating the scene in a warm, orange glow.

A tall, spiraling tower made of numerous matchsticks stands upright as a large, intense flame erupts from its top, engulfing the structure in bright, dancing fire. The fire illuminates the wooden sticks, causing them to glow and char as they burn, while the flame's movement creates a dynamic, flickering effect against the plain, dimly lit background.
A tall, spiraling tower of matches is engulfed in flames, burning intensely as the fire climbs upward, illuminating the structure against a plain, dimly lit background.
A tall, spiraling structure made of numerous matchsticks is engulfed in flames, burning intensely from the top down as the fire consumes the wooden sticks.
A wicker basket is engulfed in flames, with fire consuming its structure from the bottom up, causing the woven material to char and collapse as the fire spreads upward.
A tall, woven basket is engulfed in flames, with fire consuming its upper half and casting bright, flickering light against a dark background as it burns.
A small, intense fire rapidly grows and dances, consuming a pile of matchsticks on a light-colored floor against a plain wall.

A small, intense fire burns vigorously on a reflective surface, its bright yellow and orange flames dancing and flickering as they consume a pile of burning matchsticks. The scene is bathed in the warm, glowing light of the fire, with the background wall softly illuminated, creating a focused, intimate view of the combustion process.
A small, intense fire burns brightly in a dim, reddish-orange environment, its yellow-orange flames dancing and flickering vigorously over a pile of dark, charred material on a reflective surface.
